"import cadquery as cq

# Hard-coded task parameters (mm)
L = 100.0            # plate length along X
W = 60.0             # plate width along Y
T = 8.0              # plate thickness along Z (base at z=0)
FILLET_R = 8.0       # vertical-edge fillet radius
HOLE_D = 6.0         # through-hole diameter
HOLE_PTS = [(-35.0, -15.0),
            (35.0, -15.0),
            (-35.0, 15.0),
            (35.0, 15.0)]

# Reliable sequence: plate -> fillet vertical edges FIRST -> then through holes
part = (cq.Workplane("XY")
        .rect(L, W)                 # centered on origin in XY, base at z=0
        .extrude(T)                 # thickness along +Z
        .edges("|Z")                # the four Z-parallel vertical edges
        .fillet(FILLET_R)           # fillet BEFORE holes
        .faces(">Z").workplane()    # sketch on top face (center = origin)
        .pushPoints(HOLE_PTS)
        .circle(HOLE_D / 2.0)
        .cutThruAll())              # through the full thickness

solid = part.val()
cq.exporters.export(solid, "part.step")"
